cohort: Neonates diagnosed with perinatal asphyxia who were admitted into the special care baby unit (SCBU) of Irrua Specialist Hospital between October 2013 and September 2014.
finding: Perinatal asphyxia accounted for 13% of SCBU admissions with a mortality rate of 31.1%, and lack of antenatal care and HIE stage III were significantly associated with mortality.
